title: Giraffe reading a book
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- giraffe body -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='70' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#F2A93B'/>
  <!-- giraffe spots on body -->
  <circle cx='34' cy='64' r='3' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='44' cy='62' r='3.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='52' cy='68' r='3' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='36' cy='74' r='3' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='47' cy='74' r='3.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <!-- neck -->
  <path d='M50 66 L58 34 L66 34 L60 66 Z' fill='#F2A93B'/>
  <!-- neck spots -->
  <circle cx='57' cy='48' r='2.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='58' r='2.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <circle cx='55' cy='39' r='2.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='30' rx='11' ry='8' fill='#F2A93B'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='32' rx='5' ry='4' fill='#E8912B'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='30' r='1' fill='#6B3710'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='30' r='1' fill='#6B3710'/>
  <!-- ossicones (horns) -->
  <line x1='60' y1='23' x2='58' y2='16' stroke='#C97A22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='15' r='2.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <line x1='67' y1='23' x2='69' y2='16' stroke='#C97A22' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='69' cy='15' r='2.5' fill='#8B4A1E'/>
  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='27' rx='4' ry='2.5' fill='#E8912B' transform='rotate(-20 57 27)'/>
  <!-- eye -->
  <circle cx='66' cy='28' r='1.8' fill='#4A2408'/>
  <!-- front legs -->
  <rect x='32' y='82' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#E8912B'/>
  <rect x='42' y='82' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#E8912B'/>
  <!-- back legs -->
  <rect x='52' y='82' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#C97A22'/>
  <rect x='60' y='82' width='5' height='14' rx='2.5' fill='#C97A22'/>
  <!-- book -->
  <g transform='rotate(-8 80 74)'>
    <rect x='70' y='64' width='22' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='#4FA3D9'/>
    <path d='M81 64 L81 80' stroke='#2E6E99' stroke-width='1.5'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='68' x2='79' y2='68' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='71' x2='79' y2='71' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='73' y1='74' x2='78' y2='74' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='83' y1='68' x2='89' y2='68' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='83' y1='71' x2='89' y2='71' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <line x1='83' y1='74' x2='88' y2='74' stroke='#BEE3F5' stroke-width='1.2'/>
    <rect x='70' y='64' width='22' height='16' rx='1.5' fill='none' stroke='#7FC4E8' stroke-width='1'/>
  </g>
</svg>
